messages:
Alex: Taking over evening oncall (18:00-02:00 UTC). Quick handoff notes below — nothing critical live but a couple of things to watch.

Alex: What changed since morning:
- Deployed prefetch tuning to reduce tail latency on long sequences (PR #4827).
- Increased model-cache evict threshold to 0.6 for eu-west to free up GPU memory during batch spikes.
- Small routing tweak to prefer small-model-variants for low-cost tier (can fall back to full model).

Alex: Things to watch / observed quirks:
- Seen a small uptick in short-seq latency (~20–40ms) for hosted endpoints under burst load. Appears tied to prefetch config.
- KV cache evictions spiked twice this morning around 11:12 and 11:36 UTC in eu-west; team fixed with a temporary increase of cache size. Watch eviction_rate metric.
- One dedicated pool reported 503s during a 30s autoscaler lag window; telemetry shows scheduler delayed by ~2 cycles.

Alex: Immediate action items:
- @Lee: if eviction_rate > 0.15 for >5m, rollback prefetch tuning (revert to previous prefetch window) and ping infra.
- @Sam: keep an eye on /metrics/latency/p50,p95,p99 for hosted routes 'text.generate' and 'chat.stream' — I left a Grafana panel pinned.
- @Mariana: follow up on PR #4830 (autoscaler backoff tweak) — if we see >3 autoscaler misses in an hour, promote that PR.

Lee: noted. I can revert quickly — do we want a manual rollback or a quick canary first? :eyes:

Alex: Manual rollback is fine for the evening if eviction continues. Canary will make noise.

Sam: I see the pinned panel. I'll set a short alert rule for p99 > 800ms for the next 6 hours and mute paging thresholds to avoid noisy wakes.

Mariana: I'll triage #4830 tonight and put a short deploy window on it — target 02:30 UTC if needed. Also will add context to the PR about the autoscaler telemetry we saw.

OncallBot: Scheduled handoff recorded: from @Alex to oncall shift (18:00-02:00 UTC). Reminder: update the rotation doc after the shift if any action taken.

Alex: Extra notes/links:
- Prefetch PR: https://git.company/repo/pull/4827
- Autoscaler PR: https://git.company/repo/pull/4830
- Grafana board: https://grafana.company/d/abc123/latency-overview (pinned)
- Quick rollback command if needed:
```bash
# rollback prefetch config to previous commit
kubectl -n inference set env configmap/prefetch PREFETCH_WINDOW=0.4
kubectl rollout restart deployment/inference-runtime
```

Sam: I'll post updates here if alerts fire. Otherwise, silent watch and will hand back to morning shift with notes. :thumbsup:

Lee: Copy. I'll be online for the first hour and can revert if needed.

Mariana: Thanks — leaving a note to attach any post-shift follow-ups to the rotation doc.

Alex: Thanks team — handing off now. :wave:
